answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce time-locked collateral bonding coordinated by a liveness beacon. Agents must deposit funds above a strict collateral ledge, exposing stakes to slashing during interaction delays. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of scarce liquid capital per identity, preventing disposable nodes from flashing like a comet through the network to defraud peers. However, this barrier excludes capital-poor agents from participating.
